name: balmoral
_source: Real values from ~/Projects/Balmoral/art-bank/styles.json (5 art-direction lanes: Proof Before Letters, Ownership In Section, Chart Datum, Foolscap Ledger, Muniment Room - all five share this one core palette, confirmed by grepping every "palette" field in that file). Radius is 0px because the brief is explicit and repeated across every lane: 'no rounded corners on any rectangle, panel or frame' (Proof Before Letters negative clause) and 'orthogonal only, hairline rectangles at 0px radius' (Ownership In Section rationale). Font is the pairing named in the same rationale text: PP Acma (serif, labelling/headings) and PP Right Grotesk Compact (body/UI); PP Acma is not wired into this schema (only one display family + one mono slot exist here) so it is left as a documented gap, not silently dropped.

font.family: 'PP Right Grotesk Compact', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
